name: http1
description: HTTP/1.1 client side (RFC 9112) without I/O, one Response for each connection: requests written into a buffer and noted in order, pipelined or not, their bodies through an Upload that counts Content-Length and writes the chunked framing; an incremental response parser that takes any split of the input and hands body bytes back uncopied, for Content-Length, chunked and close-delimited bodies, the head readable once final, a close told clean or abrupt, and every misuse refused with a reason.
